confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of July London prices; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are firmest; cocktail and wine were cross-checked against beer (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.3x). Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain, roughly plus or minus 25 percent. FX: no RBA observation for 15 Oct 2026 could be retrieved (an unconfirmed 0.6955 was reported in one search summary); the fx block is the latest RBA-hosted figure found (1 Jul 2026), taken from search summaries and not re-checked, so it may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; anchors are London-specific estimates benchmarked against other major Western European capitals such as Paris, adjusted upward for London's higher central hotel and restaurant prices and July peak-season demand.
